text:
Aisha Khan: Quick follow-up from the GPU capacity postmortem. Want to lock owners for remediation tickets and a short validation plan for autoscale/quota/headroom. Keep it terse.
Jon Park: I can own scheduler tuning + PR + canary deployment.
Kevin Liu: I will handle quota changes and the cost approval flow.
Aisha Khan: High-level items: quota backstop, scheduler thresholds & bin-packing, headroom validation, surge-detection tuning, and playbook.
Lina Gomez: For surge detection, current rule (token_rate > 95 pct) spikes only. We should add a time-windowed ramp detector (rate of change over 30m).
Chris Patel: I can run the staging replay for a 48h slow-ramp pattern and capture p95/p99 + gpu_util trends.
Sarah Nguyen: I ll run anomaly batch on last 120 days and return top recurring signatures.
Jon Park: Scheduler plan (summary): reduce az-spread balancing slightly, set node_min_util=0.2, add 30s exponential smoothing to scale decisions. Will include k8s manifest canary (5%).
Aisha Khan: Please include explicit rollback steps in the PR and a short health-check script.
Jon Park: Will do. Smoke test command I ll include: `./dev/run_autoscale_smoke --nodes 3 --duration 900` and a small health-check: `scripts/check_service_health.sh`.
Devon (ops-bot): Created task AS-421: "gpu-autoscale-remediate" assigned to Jon Park, Kevin Liu, Chris Patel. Due 2024-12-09. Link: https://redwood.internal/ops/tasks/AS-421
Kevin Liu: Quota approach: add 10% burst buffer with a hard safety cap and automated cooldown (cooldown window = 20m). Need finance sign-off for incremental budget.
Aisha Khan: Kevin, please draft the finance request and attach sample cost projection for worst-case 48h ramp.
Kevin Liu: Will draft. Also adding an alert query suggestion:
```
FROM infra.metrics
SELECT mean(gpu_util) as util
WHERE cluster='prod' AND time > now() - 10m
GROUP BY time(1m)
```
Trigger if util > 88% for 6m.
Chris Patel: Validation run plan: staging 2h slow-ramp, then 1h burst. I ll post a table: qps, p95, p99, avg_gpu_util, cache_hit. ETA: Wed 09:30 PT.
Sarah Nguyen: Pattern analysis ETA: 4 business days. I ll surface 3 mitigations mapped to patterns and severity.
Aisha Khan: Action list (compact):
- Jon Park - Scheduler PR + canary + rollback steps - due 2024-12-08
- Kevin Liu - Quota proposal + finance ticket + monitoring query - due 2024-12-06
- Chris Patel - Staging validation runs + results table - due 2024-12-04
- Sarah Nguyen - 120-day pattern analysis + recommended heuristics - due 2024-12-11
- Aisha Khan - 1-page playbook and incident steps - due 2024-12-07
Devon (ops-bot): AS-421 update: 5 sub-actions, 3 owners assigned, finance pending. Next reminder: 2024-12-02 15:00 UTC.
Lina Gomez: Small ask: can we add `gpu_pool` and `workload_tag` to autoscale alerts so ops + finance can triage by team?
Kevin Liu: Good idea, I ll request the tags be added and include it in the finance attachment.
Jon Park: Regarding rollback owner: I will issue revert but triage handoff to oncall primary. Including explicit `kubectl rollout undo` and manifest id.
Chris Patel: I ll include `gpu_pool` in validation metrics and add a short CSV in the PR.
Aisha Khan: One constraint: all infra changes must run a canary for 10 minutes with automatic rollback if error rate > 1% or latency degradation > 20% vs baseline.
Jon Park: Noted, adding canary automation.
Kevin Liu: Finance ping: @Ethan M. I ll escalate if no response by EOD.
Devon (ops-bot): AS-421 status: open. 6 actions recorded. Next status ping scheduled 2024-12-03 08:00 UTC.
Aisha Khan: Thanks everyone. Please update AS-421 as you make progress and post blockers here. :thumbsup:
